title: Visual Observations Made by U. S. Astronauts (Roach)

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Gemini 7 ici, Houston nous recevez-vous ?

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Fort et clair. 7, allez-y.

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Bogey à 10 heures en haut.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Ici Houston. Répétez 7.

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Dit que nous avons un bogey à 10 heures en haut.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Roger. Gemini 7, est-ce le booster ou est-ce une véritable observation ?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Nous avons plusieurs, looks like debris up here. Véritable observation.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Vous avez plus d'informations ? Estimation de distance ou taille ?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Nous avons aussi le booster en vue.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Compris que vous avez le booster en vue, Roger.

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Ouais, nous avons a very, very many -- look like hundreds of little particles banked on the left out about 3 to 7 miles.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Understand you have many small particles going by on the left. At what distance?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Oh about -- it looks like a path of the vehicle at 90 degrees.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Roger, understand that they are about 3 to 4 miles away.

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: They are passed now they are in polar orbit.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Roger, understand they were about 3 or 4 miles away.

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: That's what it appeared like. That's roger.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Were these particles in addition to the booster and the bogey at 10 o'clock high?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Roger -- Spacecraft (Lovell) I have the booster on my side, it's a brilliant body in the sun, against a black background with trillions of particles on it.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Roger. What direction is it from you?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: It's about at my 2 o'clock position. (Lovell)

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Does that mean that it's ahead of you?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: It's ahead of us at 2 o'clock, slowly tumbling.
